items.plain: D-Link DIR-600L routers let remote attackers crash or take over the device — replace or retire affected routers.
items.summary: A remote stack-based buffer overflow in the GENA subscription handler of D-Link DIR-600L firmware 2.17b02 lets a remote attacker crash or take over the router, and a public exploit has been released.

items.plain: VMware vCenter lets attackers in without logging in — patch now, and check for compromise.
items.summary: An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service (vmdird) of VMware vCenter Server lets anyone with network access gain unauthorized access to vCenter. The flaw was exploited as a zero-day by the Armory Castle group since September 2026, and CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 20 November with a 23 November due date.

items.plain: Nexter Blocks Pro lets anyone sign up as a site administrator — update the plugin immediately.
items.summary: Unauthenticated privilege escalation in the WordPress plugin Nexter Blocks Pro up to and including 5.0.10: a crafted registration request grants the new account the full Administrator role, giving complete control over the site.

items.plain: Restrictions for BuddyPress lets strangers run code on your WordPress site — update to version 1.5.5.
items.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the WordPress plugin Restrictions for BuddyPress up to and including 1.5.4: the plugin evaluates attacker-controlled request data, so a single crafted request can run arbitrary code on the server. Fixed in 1.5.5.

items.plain: Fastify's middie lets attackers slip past login checks on protected pages — upgrade to 9.3.8.
items.summary: An authentication bypass in @fastify/middie, the middleware engine for the Fastify web framework, up to and including 9.3.7: a path-matching mismatch lets an unauthenticated client reach handlers that authentication, authorization or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect. Fixed in 9.3.8.
